note: Household debt as % of disposable income (skuldkvot), approximate yearly values consistent with SCB / Riksbanken / SEB reporting: from ~90 % in the mid-1990s to a peak of ~200 % in late 2021, down to ~173 % in 2025. totalDebt = total household debt, mdkr, Q1 2026 (SCB financial accounts via SEB). Regulation timeline: bolånetak 85 % (2010), amorteringskrav (2016), skärpt amorteringskrav (2018), and the April 2026 easing (tak 90 %, skärpning slopad, max amortering 2 %/år).
